newsitem.title: USA: Miller family takes control of Kiddie Academy.
newsitem.headline: Miller family takes control of Kiddie Academy.

text.p: Kiddie Academy International Inc said Thursday that George Miller, Pauline Miller and Michael Miller, its founding family and principal stockholders, have assumed control of the company as a result of acquiring sufficient additional stock to give them a majority of the outstanding shares.
The company said that the Millers have increased the size of the board, adding three new directors and replacing two more. A third existing director resigned today.
The newly-configured board, said Kiddie Academy, has also placed chief executive officer Angelo Bizarro on administrative leave, while Michael Miller, president, temporarily assumes his duties.

New management, said the company, is addressing the serious liquidity problems currently facing Kiddie Academy, which said in May that it had failed to complete a private placement to alleviate the problem.
Kiddid Academy operates and franchises educational-based child care centers and operates a wholesale and retail school supply and equipment distribution business.
